title: Aureline M5 stable-line refresh policy
description: Canonical per-domain refresh policy for the fresh stable line and the evidence-refresh line. Names the line class, the support window the line publishes, the evidence-refresh cadence (kept ordinary release ops rather than launch-only heroics), whether certified-archetype / compatibility / known-limits evidence has been refreshed, and the crash / rollback / support-export / migration flow protection posture so no shipping line drifts on stale evidence and support language never outruns current refresh proof. Downstream release, help, support, public-proof, shiproom, and program-governance surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a line's support-window and refresh posture by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
